name: slide-swap-button
title: Slide Swap Button
description: An interactive button with a smooth sliding icon, text exchange, and left-to-right animated background fill.

files.content: import type { AnchorHTMLAttributes, ButtonHTMLAttributes, CSSProperties, ReactNode, } from "react" /** * Public CSS variables for customizing the button. * Values can be overridden through the `style` prop. */ type SwapButtonVariables = { "--swap-btn-height"?: string "--swap-btn-radius"?: string "--swap-btn-font-size"?: string "--swap-btn-letter-spacing"?: string "--swap-btn-icon-size"?: string "--swap-btn-move-duration"?: string "--swap-btn-fill-duration"?: string "--swap-btn-color-duration"?: string "--swap-btn-easing"?: string "--swap-btn-accent"?: string "--swap-btn-text"?: string "--swap-btn-text-hover"?: string "--swap-btn-border"?: string "--swap-btn-icon-bg"?: string "--swap-btn-icon-color"?: string "--swap-btn-icon-bg-hover"?: string "--swap-btn-icon-color-hover"?: string "--swap-btn-focus-ring"?: string "--swap-btn-focus-offset"?: string } export type SwapButtonStyle = CSSProperties & SwapButtonVariables type SharedProps = { children: ReactNode icon?: ReactNode className?: string style?: SwapButtonStyle } type SwapButtonAsButton = SharedProps & Omit< ButtonHTMLAttributes, "children" | "className" | "style" | "type" > & { href?: never type?: ButtonHTMLAttributes["type"] } type SwapButtonAsLink = SharedProps & Omit< AnchorHTMLAttributes, "children" | "className" | "style" > & { href: string type?: never } export type SwapButtonProps = SwapButtonAsButton | SwapButtonAsLink const defaultStyles: SwapButtonStyle = { "--swap-btn-height": "52px", "--swap-btn-radius": "999px", "--swap-btn-font-size": "11px", "--swap-btn-letter-spacing": "2.5px", "--swap-btn-icon-size": "28px", "--swap-btn-move-duration": "var(--dur-move, 0.55s)", "--swap-btn-fill-duration": "var(--dur-fill, 0.50s)", "--swap-btn-color-duration": "var(--dur-color, 0.35s)", "--swap-btn-easing": "var(--ease-swap, cubic-bezier(0.76, 0, 0.24, 1))", "--swap-btn-accent": "var(--color-accent-red, #FF4D36)", "--swap-btn-text": "var(--color-primary-black, #0B0B0B)", "--swap-btn-text-hover": "#FFFFFF", "--swap-btn-border": "var(--color-primary-black, #FFFFFF)", "--swap-btn-icon-bg": "var(--swap-btn-accent)", "--swap-btn-icon-color": "#FFFFFF", "--swap-btn-icon-bg-hover": "#FFFFFF", "--swap-btn-icon-color-hover": "var(--swap-btn-accent)", "--swap-btn-focus-ring": "var(--swap-btn-accent)", "--swap-btn-focus-offset": "transparent", } /** * Main button styling. * * Tailwind handles the structure, background wipe, * typography, colors, focus ring, and transitions. */ const buttonClasses = [ "group relative isolate inline-flex", "h-[var(--swap-btn-height)]", "items-center justify-start", "overflow-hidden", "rounded-[var(--swap-btn-radius)]", "border border-[color:var(--swap-btn-border)]", "bg-transparent", "pl-14 pr-4", "font-mono font-semibold uppercase leading-none", "text-[length:var(--swap-btn-font-size)]", "tracking-[var(--swap-btn-letter-spacing)]", "transition-colors", "duration-[var(--swap-btn-color-duration)]", "hover:text-[color:var(--swap-btn-text-hover)]", "focus-visible:text-[color:var(--swap-btn-text-hover)]", "before:absolute before:inset-0 before:z-0", "before:origin-left before:scale-x-0", "before:bg-[var(--swap-btn-accent)]", "before:content-['']", "before:transition-transform", "before:duration-[var(--swap-btn-fill-duration)]", "before:ease-[var(--swap-btn-easing)]", "hover:before:scale-x-100", "focus-visible:before:scale-x-100", ].join(" ") /** * Label movement: * Default: translate3d(0, 0, 0) * Hover: translate3d(-(icon size + 12px), 0, 0) * * This keeps the label and icon synchronized even * when the icon size is customized. */ const labelClasses = [ "relative z-10 inline-block", "translate-x-0", "transition-transform", "duration-[var(--swap-btn-move-duration)]", "ease-[var(--swap-btn-easing)]", "group-hover:-translate-x-10", "group-focus-visible:-translate-x-10", ].join(" ") const iconPositionClasses = [ "absolute left-3 top-1/2 z-10", "h-7 w-7", "-translate-y-1/2", "transition-[left]", "duration-[var(--swap-btn-move-duration)]", "ease-[var(--swap-btn-easing)]", "group-hover:left-[calc(100%_-_40px)]", "group-focus-visible:left-[calc(100%_-_40px)]", ].join(" ") const iconBadgeClasses = [ "grid h-full w-full place-items-center", "rounded-full", "bg-[var(--swap-btn-icon-bg)]", "text-[color:var(--swap-btn-icon-color)]", "transition-colors", "duration-[var(--swap-btn-color-duration)]", "ease-[var(--swap-btn-easing)]", "group-hover:bg-[var(--swap-btn-icon-bg-hover)]", "group-hover:text-[color:var(--swap-btn-icon-color-hover)]", "group-focus-visible:bg-[var(--swap-btn-icon-bg-hover)]", "group-focus-visible:text-[color:var(--swap-btn-icon-color-hover)]", "[&>svg]:h-3.5 [&>svg]:w-3.5", "[&>svg]:shrink-0", ].join(" ") function DefaultArrowIcon() { return ( ) } export function SlideSwapButton(props: SwapButtonProps) { const { children, icon, className, style, href, type, ...nativeProps } = props // Merge defaults with custom design tokens. const mergedStyle: SwapButtonStyle = { ...defaultStyles, ...style, } // Shared visual content. const content = ( <> {children} {icon ?? } ) const combinedClasses = [buttonClasses, className].filter(Boolean).join(" ") // Render an anchor whenever href is supplied. if (typeof href === "string") { return ( )} href={href} className={combinedClasses} style={mergedStyle} > {content} ) } // Otherwise render a native button. return ( ) }
